facts.statement: IER enables and disables interrupt generation by the UART.
facts.quote: This register allows enabling and disabling interrupt generation by the UART.

facts.statement: IER bit 0 controls Received Data available interrupt disabled when 0 enabled when 1.
IER bit 1 controls Transmitter Holding Register empty interrupt.
facts.quote: 1 RW Transmitter Holding Register empty interrupt

facts.statement: IER bit 2 controls Receiver Line Status Interrupt.
IER bit 3 controls Modem Status Interrupt.
IIR bit 0 reports interrupt pending when 0.
facts.quote: Bit 0 indicates that an interrupt is pending when it’s logic ‘0’.

facts.statement: IIR reports no interrupt pending when 1.
